handover_protocol.rule: Live GitHub state outranks this snapshot. Fresh-reconcile main, open PRs/branches/CI/deployments and generated child-programme state before mutation.

lane.name: Culinary App / Culinary Lab — Post Legal Corpus Baseline

operating_contract.autonomy: Ordinary bounded repository implementation, expected CI and no-write evidence audits are standing-preapproved under AGENTS.md. No human gate is active. Stop at genuine cost/access/security/topology/rights gates, an unrecoverable error, or a terminal material result.
operating_contract.normalization: Mapping V1 is frozen as a reversible overlay. Raw cuisine/culture/tags/collection remain source hints; no tradition/region/dietary authority was guessed. UNKNOWN and AMBIGUOUS remain first-class.
operating_contract.nutrition: The next lane is an applicability audit, not automatic nutrition authority. Preserve the approved European-primary source policy, nutrient-semantic firewall, exact provenance, fail-partial/fail-closed behavior and no guessing. Imported/source recipe content does not become authoritative nutrition evidence merely because it is present in the protected corpus.
operating_contract.storage: Protected recipe bodies remain private in Cloudflare D1. Mapping V1 performed zero D1 reads/writes and zero protected-body export/rewrite. Begin the nutrition applicability audit from exact pinned-source reconstruction plus existing public-safe nutrition evidence unless a separately justified D1 read gate is earned.
operating_contract.d1: Optimized operational target remains <=8 D1 subqueries/request. Hard fail-safe 16 is not spendable headroom. Preserve exactly two shards and delta-route ancestry.
operating_contract.public_activation: Public runtime remains 85 recipes. Broader public corpus or recommendation admission is not authorized by Mapping V1.
operating_contract.billing_firewall: No paid infrastructure, billing enablement or automatic overage authorization.

normalization_baseline.interpretation: Raw source signals are heterogeneous and not semantically interchangeable. Tags/culture are broad but noisy; category and difficulty mix incompatible vocabularies/scales. First implementation must be a reversible overlay with explicit UNKNOWN/AMBIGUOUS states.

not_authorized: No protected-body rewrite or D1 mutation from Mapping V1.
No new source cohort or v8019 population from this lane.
No automatic nutrition authority or nutrient inference from imported recipe data.
No paid infrastructure or billing expansion.
No YT-CUL live Search while DAILY_SEARCH_HOLD_POLICY_OR_QUOTA is active.
No Knowledge Core write from app lane unless separately authorized.

next_action.action: Perform a bounded no-write nutrition/vitamin applicability audit over protected v8018 / 19,268 using the exact pinned-source reconstruction, frozen Mapping V1 metadata and the app's existing reviewed nutrition evidence/policies. Measure which records have sufficient ingredient identity, quantity/portion semantics and evidence coverage for authoritative calculation; separate macro versus vitamin/mineral applicability; classify blockers and explicit UNKNOWN/AMBIGUOUS states; preserve European-primary source selection, nutrient-semantic firewalls and exact provenance. Freeze acceptance criteria and the candidate applicability model before any D1 mutation, recommendation admission or public behavior change.

terminal_instruction_for_new_chat: Continue the Culinary App / Culinary Recommender lane from docs/handovers/CURRENT.json. Fresh-reconcile live GitHub first. Protected production remains v8018 / 19,268, 18 hydration layers, exactly two shards, maxObservedD1Subqueries=8 and public runtime 85. LEGAL_CORPUS_BASELINE_PASS, normalization baseline PASS and CORPUS_NORMALIZATION_CATEGORIZATION_MAPPING_V1_PASS__FROZEN are earned. Mapping V1 produced 19,268/19,268 valid unique reversible overlays with deliberately narrow authority: 501 explicit countries, 1,079 reviewed dish categories, 524 reviewed meal roles, 1,416 difficulty mappings, 501 prep, 501 cook, 870 exact + 501 reviewed total-time values with 45 explicit ambiguities, and 501 servings; region/tradition/technique-family/reviewed-dietary authority remains UNKNOWN where not earned. The next autonomous lane is NUTRITION_VITAMIN_APPLICABILITY_AUDIT: begin with a bounded no-write audit using exact pinned-source reconstruction, frozen mapping and existing reviewed nutrition evidence/policies; measure applicability and blockers before mutation. No guessing, no protected-body/D1 mutation, no recommendation/public widening, no third shard, no billing, no YT-CUL retry and no Knowledge Core writes.

roadmap_reconciliation.note: Post-baseline product order remains controlling. Recommendation readiness follows the nutrition/vitamin applicability audit; Recipe Family and YouTube refinement remain downstream.

semantics: Country authority only from explicit source country.
Cuisine/culture/tags/collection are retained as source hints and are not promoted to culinary tradition/authenticity.
ForkRecipe activeTime is not relabeled as prep time.
Difficulty source scales are preserved without false cross-scale equivalence.
Dish category and meal role use separate reviewed controlled vocabularies.
Dietary authority remains UNKNOWN in Mapping V1.
